risk_notes: CUDA Toolkit version is not pinned; build reproducibility depends on whatever nvcc/cuda_runtime is installed on the host.
Target GPU architecture is hard-coded to sm_60; running on older devices will fail and on newer devices may miss optimizations, but this is a correctness/perf note rather than a supply-chain risk.
No package manager, lockfile, or container image is referenced, so the toolchain provenance (CUDA install source) is entirely implicit and unverified.

supply_chain_meaning: Static manifest/install-pattern scan; LLM dependency extraction from agent output; OSV lookup attempted (no matching advisories or no pinned versions).
